title: Collatz: Lean minimum bad multiple and descent through two odd runs
body:
## Minimum bad multiple and adaptive ordinary descent

**Collatz remains OPEN.** This continuation uses four GPT-6.2 Astra research agents, independent mathematical reviews, and a coordinator proof connecting the minimum to the actual basin of 1. The closing work changes from a minimum over units to a minimum over all odd tripling disagreements, then follows the original bad component through its actual first and second odd runs.

**Published head:** `26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3`  
**Complete science commit:** `f4453eff99bf9d0315404c6931e1c70e5c93cefe`  
**Science tree:** `84f47c53bf48896050746c785e7a7aa4e9a923de`

[Scientific overview](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/research/astra-minimum-source-20261124/README.md) · [Coordinator review](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/reports/astra-minimum-source-20261124/ROOT_REVIEW.md) · [Pinned source intake](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/research/astra-minimum-source-20261124/SOURCES.md)

### 1. A Lean-proved minimum of actual counterexamples

If a positive counterexample exists, let q be the least positive odd integer whose basin label differs from that of 3q. Multiples of three and both label orientations are included. A complete elementary table and strong induction prove:

- q is good and 3q is bad; every positive integer through q is good.
- Every positive n with 8n+1<9q is good. The strict endpoint is retained.
- Every smaller positive multiple of three is good, including even multiples.
- For the least positive counterexample N, q<N and (9q−1)/8≤N≤3q.

The actual basin is defined as existence of a finite iterate equal to 1. The Lean theorem constructs this minimum from a counterexample and proves its orientation; it does not assume an unproved tripling implication.

[Complete smaller-source table](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/research/astra-minimum-source-20261124/arithmetic/README.md) · [Actual-basin minimum theorem](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/research/astra-minimum-source-20261124/minimal/MinimumFailure.lean)

### 2. Descent through the actual second odd run

Write 3q=2^m a−1 with a odd. If 1≤m≤3 and the first exit survives with 3^m a≡3 mod4, set U=(3^(m−1)a−1)/4. Then 0<U<q and the next odd state is y=6U+1. Factor y+1=2^ell b with b odd. If 3^ell b≡1 mod4, the original upper member and the smaller multiple meet:

`T^(m+ell+3)(3q) = T^(ell+1)(3U) = (3^ell b−1)/4`.

The second run can be arbitrarily long. There is an explicit infinite CRT family with m=3, any prescribed v3(3q)≥3 and ell≥7, outside the earlier fixed source rows and the complementary first-exit class. The actual-basin contradiction is kernel checked; CRT existence is a written argument. The opposite second exit and m≥4 remain open under this proof.

[Second-run proof and infinite family](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/research/astra-minimum-source-20261124/second/README.md) · [SecondRun.lean](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/research/astra-minimum-source-20261124/second/SecondRun.lean)

### 3. Other genuine source reductions

- Entire fixed source classes q≡7 mod8, q≡1 mod128 (q>1), and q≡−21 mod8192 are excluded. The last uses different clocks and no ternary restriction.
- The full progression q=3007+4374t has a smaller pair x=2815+4096t with the two actual components exchanged. All t≥0 are permitted by the new odd minimum.
- If 3q=3^h w=2^m a−1 with h≥3, the downward first-exit parity produces the actual good representative 2^h w−1<q. Additional residue cases and the complementary 147 mod256 merger operate at the true, unbounded exit clock.
- On the stated surviving h≥3,m≥3 branch, the canonical failed source is exactly B(U)=3q<3N. This improves the earlier factor below 171 to 3 on that branch; it does not exclude the remaining branch.

[Adaptive and paired descent](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/research/astra-minimum-source-20261124/descent/README.md) · [Independent first-exit proof](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/research/astra-minimum-source-20261124/renewal/README.md)

The latest PR201 update at 2978d84f was read. Its elementary central-row inverse multiplicity does not supply a smaller bad root: any exact (b,2b) source in this bad component satisfies x≥v(5/4)^b, with v>q, and thus exceeds 3q for b≥5. No opposing upper bound for that paper's finite statistic is claimed.

### 4. Executed verification and publication

- Five new Lean modules, **46 public theorem declarations**, all compiled with warnings as errors and an individual axiom audit. Only propext, Classical.choice and Quot.sound occur; no proof placeholders or native decision escapes.
- Four Python controls, ordinary and optimized executions byte-identical, with zero AST assertions. Coverage includes 100,000 table inputs, complete affine progression controls, first-exit and second-exit paths, and 171 constructed CRT valuation pairs.
- The first scientific commit was fetched and replayed in a clean complete 697-file checkout. The complete scientific commit was then fetched and replayed independently in a clean complete 701-file checkout after the second-run theorem was added.
- The receipt follow-up changes reports only. The final published commit was fetched and validated again in a clean complete **734-file** checkout, tree `a4e75ec7d6b0c7a40095fdd59b193a96d4ba5ab3`. All five validator commands passed and all 15 scientific file hashes matched the full replay.

Lean 4.34.1 (`5045d0056413266e57c625dcd7c365b10e377c52`), mathlib `d13f23b723b8a846827a245b89c10fc7d3f11612`. Existing dependency objects were reused; earlier unchanged research and upstream tables are not claimed as rebuilt. Repository integrity is not a proof of the missing universal theorem.

[Verification scope](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/reports/astra-minimum-source-20261124/VERIFICATION.md) · [Complete replay receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/reports/astra-minimum-source-20261124/fresh_replay/receipt.json) · [Validator receipt](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/reports/astra-minimum-source-20261124/fresh_replay/repository-validation.json) · [Publication binding](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/reports/astra-minimum-source-20261124/PUBLICATION.json)

**Remaining obligation:** prove that every surviving least q yields a good ordinary representative, a smaller bad multiple of three, or a smaller odd disagreement. The new results prove this on their exact domains; the universal quantifier is still unproved.

Earlier scientific packets remain unchanged. [Previous PR description](https://github.com/GettysburgResearch/collatz/blob/26f070c38ad9edd21ed7dac6efaab6554550c2a3/reports/astra-minimum-source-20261124/PREVIOUS_PR_DESCRIPTION.json) preserves the preceding checkpoint. This remains a draft research PR.
